tee_shift.note: 2026-10-23: moved 10 yd back (tests/tools/teeshift.js) after the low-spin run-out, so a pure drive leaves a full iron again; it had been 50. The game tee was moved 40 yd forward along the hole for the OpenFairway physics (docs/holes/standrews-17.md §6): every z in the HOLES entry is 40 yd less than this frame gives (the sheds and hotel of that time moved with the tee; since 2026-10-23 the tee-shot landmarks are placed by `landmarks.shift`). Subtract 40 from z in lidar.py output before pasting it into the hole.

lidar.source: Scottish Public Sector LiDAR Phase 5, 50 cm DTM, tiles NO41NE_50CM_DTM_PHASE5.tif and NO51NW_50CM_DTM_PHASE5.tif (Open Government Licence v3), from srsp-open-data.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com (lidar/phase-5/dtm/27700/gridded/). Not in the repo (383 + 206 MB)
lidar.crs: EPSG:27700 (British National Grid), heights ODN m
lidar.located_by: map pins from the project owner on the green (56.343195, -2.808815), placed at the game pin (18, 470), and on the back tee by the Old Course Hotel (56.345991, -2.813011)

frame.why: tee -> pin is 405.1 m at 140.9 degrees (the owner's two pins; both yardage pages put the green south-east of the hotel tee); the game's tee -> pin is 470 yd with the pin 18 yd left, so +z is 2.2 degrees right of that line and yd_per_m = 470.3 / 405.1

landmarks.source: Scottish Public Sector LiDAR Phase 5, 50 cm DSM (surface model: rooftops, walls, trees) with the DTM, tiles NO41NE and NO51NW (Open Government Licence v3), from srsp-open-data.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com (lidar/phase-5/dsm/27700/gridded/ and .../dtm/...). Not in the repo (376 + 201 MB DSM). Heights above the ground = DSM - DTM, sampled on this file's lidar.frame grid
landmarks.reference: the owner's screen recording of St Andrews Links' own drone flyover of the 17th (a Facebook reel); not in the repo. It fixed the tee (left of the wall), the shed's boards, roof and sign, the wall, path and netting

shift.why: z: the tee shift above. x: the frame's tee is the owner's back-tee pin, on the wall's line, while the tee in the flyover is left of the wall; the landmarks are moved 10 yd right so they stand from the game tee as they do from the real one (the green, road and bunkers keep the frame)

frame_measured.note: corners and lines in this file's lidar frame (game yards, before the shift); heights in metres

wall.note: the 1 m stone wall round the hotel's grounds: straight from beside the tee to the corner, straight again down the right

shed_quads.heights_m: front 4.6 eaves + 1.9 ridge, rear 4.0 + 1.7, back 3.4 flat

frame_measured.trees: a canopy 10-18 m high behind and right of the tee (centre (-22, 36), ~15 yd across); shrubs and small trees in the garden behind the shed

game.note: what index.html uses (frame + shift; heights x 1.161)
